title: HL7 v2 to FHIR hard case manifest (case.yaml)
description: Manifest of one case under cases/<NNN>-<short-slug>/. A case with status 'todo' may omit most fields and may have no accepted answers; a case with status 'ready' must be complete. A single-message case has message.hl7, message_type and trigger_event. A multi-message case lists its messages under 'messages' and states what must be true after each one under 'accepted_end_states'.

id.description: Must equal the case folder name: a three-digit number and a short slug.

status.description: 'todo': work in progress, accepted_answers may be empty and message.hl7 may be missing. 'ready': complete.

summary.description: What the case contains and why it is hard.

v2_version.description: HL7 v2 version as in MSH-12, e.g. '2.5.1'. Quote it in YAML.

trigger_event.description: Trigger event as declared in MSH-9.2. If other fields disagree (e.g. EVN-1), say so in the summary.

messages.description: Multi-message cases only, in place of message.hl7, message_type and trigger_event. One entry per message file, listed in arrival order. Arrival order is declared, not derived from MSH-7 or EVN-2, because the gap between them is often what the case tests.

trigger_event.description: Trigger event as declared in MSH-9.2.

hop.description: 'v2-to-enterprise' should be lossless and gets a strict diff. 'enterprise-to-repository' is lossy by design.

initiates_workflow.description: Declared by the case, not inferred: whether the message initiates a workflow (e.g. a Task).

validation.description: What a pass covers. Two tools can both say 'pass' after validating different things.

packages.description: Pinned package set. Exact versions only, never 'latest', 'current' or ranges.

snomed_edition.description: SNOMED CT edition module id, e.g. '900000000000207008' (International), or an edition/version URI such as 'http://snomed.info/sct/900000000000207008/version/20250101'. Quote it in YAML.

scope.description: What was validated. 'bundle-and-entries': the Bundle including all its entries. 'end-states': for multi-message cases, the Encounters declared in accepted_end_states after each message; no Bundle is validated.

accepted_end_states.description: Multi-message cases only. One entry per accepted reconciliation, each with the rule it follows and the expected state after each message. Two accepted end states can agree at the end and differ along the way, so the state is declared after every message, not only the last.

reconciliation_rule.description: Declared input, like the transaction: how the converter is allowed to reconcile the messages.

after_message.description: arrival_order of the message after which this state must hold.

encounters.description: Every Encounter that must exist for the case's visits at that point. An empty list means none.

accepted_answers.description: One entry per accepted answer. More than one is normal; each states its rationale and the exchange pattern it serves.

declared_losses.description: Information the conversion is expected to drop, and why. An empty list states that nothing is lost.

source.description: e.g. 'EVN-1', or a FHIR path for the enterprise-to-repository hop.

attachments.description: Embedded attachments. The original binary is stored under attachments/ and its SHA-256 is recorded here.

segment_field.description: Where the attachment is embedded, e.g. 'OBX-5'.

occurrence.description: 1-based occurrence of that segment in the message. Default 1.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the original bytes.

scrubbing_method.description: Required when provenance is 'scrubbed': how identifying data was removed or replaced.

notes.description: Optional free text about the case itself, e.g. corrections to a previously published version.

assigner.description: Assigning authority as sent, e.g. CX.4.1.

type.description: Identifier type code as sent, e.g. 'VN'.

encounter_state.description: What must be true of one Encounter. Fields left out are not checked.

linked_identifiers.description: Other visit identifiers, e.g. from a second sender, that must resolve to this same Encounter. The reconciliation rule states which identifiers get linked.

period_start.description: FHIR dateTime with offset. Quote it in YAML.

period_end.description: FHIR dateTime with offset. Quote it in YAML.

attending.description: Attending practitioner identifier as sent, e.g. XCN.1.
